app_info.subtitle: Enrich and research data
app_info.description: Riveter helps users enrich tabular data, build targeted datasets, run web searches and scrapes, extract structured records, and schedule recurring monitors from ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts an enrichment run that fills cells on a dataset or on inline rows, consumes credits, and may create configuration records in the user's Riveter account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Runs AI agents that search and read the public web to fill each cell, and can POST completed results to a caller-supplied webhook URL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Writes new cell values and run data without deleting rows, columns, or the saved enrichment configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the current status and metadata of an existing run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, stop, or otherwise modify the run.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an existing run's status and available output, with an optional read-only long poll.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish or transmit results to an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter the run or its stored results.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes a running Riveter job to a stopped state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes the run inside the user's private Riveter account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Stops the selected run, and the run cannot be resumed afterward.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists runs and applies read-only filters and pagination.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or remove any listed run.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves aggregate run counts by status for the authenticated account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to any external or publicly visible system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the runs included in the summary.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists saved enrichments and their visible configuration metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not affect systems outside the user's Riveter account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not add, update, rename, or delete enrichment columns.

justifications.read_only_justification: Saves a new enrichment configuration (task prompt and output columns) and the empty dataset bound to it, or answers a dataset's own enrichment; it does not run anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates records only inside the user's private Riveter account; fetches no web page and contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new resources without deleting or overwriting an existing enrichment or dataset.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the structure and configuration of a saved enrichment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the enrichment or its columns.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds, updates, renames, deletes, or reorders columns in a saved enrichment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes configuration inside the user's private Riveter account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can delete columns or overwrite existing column configuration and ordering.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a saved enrichment configuration from the user's Riveter account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Acts only on a record inside the user's private Riveter account; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the enrichment and its column configuration; the deletion cannot be undone.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new dataset in the user's account from rows the caller sends, or starts a billable build run that generates rows from a description and can optionally start a fill run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Generating rows researches the public web, and the call can POST completed build or fill results to caller-supplied webhook URLs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new dataset and runs without deleting or overwriting an existing dataset.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists the datasets in the authenticated account with their column and row counts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the user's own Riveter account only; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or remove any listed dataset.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one dataset's columns, row count, bound enrichment id, and recent runs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the user's own Riveter account only; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the dataset, its rows, or its columns.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renames the dataset, changes its index column, adds, renames, or removes input and output columns, and sets the per-row budget on its enrichment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes configuration inside the user's private Riveter account; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Removing a column deletes every value stored under it, and a changed prompt marks the column's cells stale; neither is recoverable.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a dataset and every row and cell it holds from the user's Riveter account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Acts only on records inside the user's private Riveter account; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the dataset, its rows, and its cells; the deletion cannot be undone.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists a dataset's rows with their input values and cell values, with read-only cursor pagination.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the user's own Riveter account only; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or remove any listed row.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only counts a dataset's cells by state and its most common values per column; reads no rows into the response and changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the user's own Riveter account only; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only aggregate; cannot modify or delete.

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends rows the caller sends to a dataset in the user's account; no credits are consumed.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only inside the user's private Riveter account; fetches no web page and contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Append-only: existing rows and cells are never removed or overwritten, and duplicate rows are skipped.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes up to 100 rows, named by id or position, from a dataset in the user's account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Acts only on records inside the user's private Riveter account; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the named rows and their cell values; the deletion cannot be undone.

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends the rows of a caller-supplied CSV to a dataset in the user's account; no credits are consumed.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only inside the user's private Riveter account; fetches no web page and contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Append-only: existing rows and cells are never removed or overwritten, and duplicate rows are skipped.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a billable build run that generates additional rows for an existing dataset and can optionally start a fill run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Researches the public web to generate the rows, and can POST completed build or fill results to caller-supplied webhook URLs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Append-only: existing rows and cells are never removed or overwritten, and duplicate rows are skipped.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sets one row's input values and output cells by hand in the user's account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only inside the user's private Riveter account; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the row's existing input values and cell values, and a null clears a cell; the previous values are not recoverable.

justifications.read_only_justification: Converts an output column of a dataset into an input column, moving every row's value with it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes configuration and stored values inside the user's private Riveter account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Removes the output column and its prompt from the enrichment; the column's configuration is not recoverable, although the values are kept as input values.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only renders the dataset's rows and cells as a CSV, Excel, or JSON Lines file.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the user's own Riveter account only; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the dataset, its rows, or its columns.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a billable dataset-build run from a configured template in the user's account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can POST completed dataset results to a caller-supplied webhook URL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new build without modifying or deleting the configured template.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a billable run of an existing extraction plan and stores the resulting run record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can POST extracted records to a caller-supplied webhook URL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new run without deleting or overwriting the extraction plan.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a persistent extraction plan, starts discovery, and applies the plan's service credit charge.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches arbitrary public web pages at the caller-supplied URL to plan the extraction. It interacts with external websites outside Riveter, though it only reads them.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new plan without deleting or overwriting an existing plan.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves an extraction plan's lifecycle state and user-facing definition.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change the plan's source website or any third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not run, modify, or delete the extraction plan.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists monitor schedules belonging to the authenticated account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send monitor results or modify external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, pause, resume, or repoint any monitor.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a recurring monitor schedule and can optionally start its first enrichment run immediately.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can send scheduled monitor results or change alerts to a caller-supplied webhook URL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new schedule without deleting or overwriting the underlying enrichment.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the selected monitor's schedule, state, and delivery configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not run the monitor or send results to its webhook.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not pause, resume, repoint, or delete the monitor.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes whether a monitor is enabled or replaces its webhook delivery URL.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can repoint future monitor results to a caller-supplied external webhook URL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Pause, resume, and webhook changes are reversible and do not delete the monitor.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists historical runs for the selected monitor with optional filters and pagination.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not execute the monitor or contact its webhook.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify the monitor or any listed run.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs a web search, consumes service credits, and persists a run and its results in the user's account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Web search: queries the open internet and returns results from arbitrary external websites. Read-only toward those sites, but the domain of interaction is the public web, not a closed system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a search record without deleting or overwriting account data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts an agent run, consumes service credits, and stores the answer in the user's Riveter account.
justifications.open_world_justification: An agent that searches and browses arbitrary public websites to answer the prompt. It interacts with the open web; it only reads pages and does not post, submit forms, or message anyone.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new run without deleting or overwriting existing account resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Performs a scrape, consumes service credits, and creates a run record in the user's account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches the caller-supplied URL from the public internet and returns its text. It interacts with an arbitrary external website, though it only reads it and changes nothing there.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates scrape results without deleting or overwriting user resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves plan, credit balance, account identity, and API key metadata for the authenticated account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not transmit data to or change any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify account, billing, or API key settings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists the research tools an enrichment may use, with their prices and whether the account may use each.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the user's own Riveter account only; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change any tool setting, enrichment, or account configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns reference text about how to use the other tools; it calls no API and reads no account data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns static documentation bundled with the tool catalog; contacts no external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns documentation only; cannot modify or delete anything.

test_cases.description: Run a saved enrichment and retrieve its completed row-level results.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my enrichments, use the demo enrichment named Company Research to enrich Apple and Stripe, wait for the run to finish, and show me the results.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds the named demo enrichment, starts one enrichment run with matching input columns, and returns its completed results or a clear terminal status.

test_cases.description: Build a targeted dataset from a natural-language specification and retrieve its rows.
test_cases.user_prompt: Build a dataset of 10 US-based B2B SaaS companies founded since 2020, including each company's website and headquarters city, then wait for the rows and show them to me.
test_cases.expected_output: Starts a dataset-build run using the requested row count and constraints, then reads the new dataset's rows and returns up to 10 structured company rows when the run completes.

test_cases.description: Put rows the user has into a dataset, fill two columns on them, and read the grid back.
test_cases.user_prompt: Make a dataset with the companies Apple, Stripe, and Shopify, add columns for the CEO and the headquarters city, fill them in, and show me the table.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one dataset holding the three rows and two output columns, starts one fill run on it, and returns the three rows with their CEO and headquarters values or a clear terminal status.

test_cases.description: Research a current topic and inspect a relevant public webpage.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search for recent public news about Riveter, then scrape the Riveter homepage and summarize the most relevant findings with source URLs.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant web-search results and webpage content, then summarizes only information supported by the retrieved sources.

test_cases.description: Discover, run, and retrieve a structured extraction from a public test site.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an extraction for https://quotes.toscrape.com/ that returns each quote and author, wait until the extraction is ready, run it, and show me the first records.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates and polls an extraction plan, starts one extraction run after it is ready, and returns records containing quote and author fields.

test_cases.description: Create, verify, and pause a recurring enrichment monitor.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using the demo enrichment named Company Research, create a daily monitor for 9:00 AM UTC without running it immediately, verify its schedule, and then pause it.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one daily monitor for the demo enrichment, confirms the 9:00 AM UTC schedule, pauses it, and reports that it is disabled.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Riveter for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no calendar or scheduling-calendar access.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Riveter to send an email or external message.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my sales team announcing our new pricing.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot compose and send arbitrary email or messages to recipients.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim support for account administration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Revoke all my Riveter API keys, change my billing plan, and invite my teammate to the account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should explain that API key revocation, billing changes, and team invitations are unsupported and point to the Riveter app settings instead of invoking another Riveter tool as a substitute.
